stages.title: The Closet
stages.notes: Minimum board (3x5), open. Two armies one rank apart — the knife-fight lower bound. Tests: does a duel this cramped even read as chess?

stages.title: Cracked Hall
stages.notes: Narrow hall, sparse rubble offset left-then-right. Lightest possible terrain interference.

stages.title: The Squeeze
stages.notes: Off-center waist: the left side collapses to a 2-wide pass. Armies must fight through or around one choke. Asymmetric on purpose.

stages.title: Pillared Court
stages.notes: Two lone pillars, diagonal offset. Classic cover: cuts long files/diagonals without shaping rooms.

stages.title: Collapsed Gallery
stages.notes: Rubble clump on the left flank mid-board; right flank fully open. Flank-choice terrain.

stages.title: The Doorway
stages.notes: A wall line with one 2-wide door, off-center. The purest chokepoint: all traffic funnels through files d-e.

stages.title: Twin Chambers
stages.notes: Partial spine splits the board into two rooms connected top and bottom. Two-theater duels; rook files die at the spine.

stages.title: The Shelf
stages.notes: Corner bite INTO the north deployment zone — the molding showcase: black cannot deploy wide-left and must squish right. Tests deployment on broken ground.

stages.title: Long Nave
stages.notes: Long and narrow (4x10) with staggered pillars. Deep approach marches; promotion runs matter.

stages.title: Broken Crossing
stages.notes: Two broken wall arms leave three routes of different widths. Route-choice terrain at mid scale.

stages.title: Grand Hall
stages.notes: The 10x10 upper bound: mostly open, three scattered pillars, a two-cell alcove on the east wall. Tests wide-board play, search cost, and phone rendering.

stages.title: Rat Warren
stages.notes: Dense pockets (13 walls): parallel 1-2 wide runs and dead ends. The wall-density stress case — quake starvation, locked pawns, fall-through.

stages.title: Gatehouse
stages.notes: Wave 2. Wall stubs inside BOTH back ranks: black loses its corners, white loses its left pair. Each army molds around its own gate before the fight starts.

stages.title: Buried Flank
stages.notes: Wave 2. Opposite flanks of the two back ranks are rubbled over (3 cells each, plus spill into the second rank). Armies deploy shifted toward opposite sides — built-in diagonal confrontation.

stages.title: Colonnade
stages.notes: Wave 2. Pillar pairs INSIDE both pawn ranks (2 and 8) plus midfield columns. Pawn screens must form around the pillars — the pawn-row molding case.

stages.title: Cave Mouth
stages.notes: Wave 2. White back rank is walled except a 2-cell mouth (b1-c1): the whole army molds forward through it, royal wedged in the mouth. Black side open — maximum deployment asymmetry.

stages.title: Rubble Start
stages.notes: Wave 2. The inverse of wave 1: rubble concentrated in ranks 1-2 and 7-8, midfield CLEAR. All the terrain pain is at deployment, none in the fight.

stages.title: Split Pockets
stages.notes: Wave 2. Wall spurs divide both back ranks into two pockets. A wide army must mold into two clumps around its spur — the split-deployment case.

stages.title: Diagonal Scar
stages.notes: Wave 2. A broken diagonal streak from a1 to h9 touching both deployment zones. Neither side deploys clean; the scar leaves slip-gaps for king-steps and diagonal sliders.

stages.title: The Anvil
stages.notes: Wave 2. Narrow board; white SECOND rank has a center wall pair (the pawn screen must split around it), black back corners clipped. Pawn-rank molding under compression.

stages.title: Collapsed Keep
stages.notes: Wave 2. The big broken-ground case at 10x10: rubble in both first AND second ranks plus midfield rooms. Everything molds, everywhere, at the size ceiling.

stages.title: Sinkhole
stages.notes: Wave 2. A 2x2 central sink plus one wall in each back rank. The minimal broken-deployment stage — one obstruction per army, one hazard mid-board.

stages.title: The Neck
stages.notes: Wave 3. Room-corridor-room: two open chambers joined by a weaving 2-wide neck (ranks 4-6). The duel starts in separate rooms — covers the topology no locked stage has.

stages.title: Hypostyle Hall
stages.notes: Wave 3. A pillar LATTICE across ranks 4-5 (alternating cells): no file crosses cleanly — sliders are denied vertically, knights and kings weave through. The dense-pillar case.

stages.title: The Divide
stages.notes: Wave 3. A full spine (ranks 2-8) splits the board into two corridors joined only at the deployment ranks: fight both fronts or race the ends. The two-front case.

stages.title: The Flats
stages.notes: Wave 3. WIDE-SHALLOW (10x6): armies start two ranks apart across a broad front — immediate contact chess, never covered by the tall locked sets. Light rubble incl. deployment intrusions.

stages.title: Posterngate
stages.notes: Wave 3. Each back rank is walled except a 2-cell gate at OPPOSITE corners: both royals start cornered, armies mold diagonally. The cornered-royal case.

stages.title: The Parapet
stages.notes: Wave 3. White second rank walled except two slots: the pawn screen is forced DEEP (rank 3+) — the universal double-step earning its keep. Black side lightly bitten for contrast.

stages.title: The Redoubt
stages.notes: Wave 3. A one-door corner chamber (door at h6) in black-deployment territory, rest open: the natural FORTRESS pocket — the stall scenario the Director exists to break. Prime meter-lab terrain.

stages.title: The Serpent
stages.notes: Wave 3. Overlapping wall arms force an S-weave up the long board: no straight path exists. Approach marches under permanent cover, the serpentine case.

stages.title: Ruined L
stages.notes: Wave 3. The NE quadrant is gone: an L-shaped playfield. Black deploys on a 5-wide shelf, white on the full 9 — the non-rectangular, unequal-area case.

stages.title: Knifework
stages.notes: Wave 3. Minimum width WITH terrain: staggered walls turn a 3-wide corridor into alternating 2-wide passes. Single-file knife fight — 3-wide has only ever been tested open.

stages.title: The Cell
stages.notes: Wave 3. The smallest square (5x5), one off-center pillar in the single gap rank. Shallow, tiny, instant: the lower-bound brawl with terrain.
